config.label: CIE AS & A Level Sociology
config.author: Smartious Homeschool
config.description: The complete Smartious course notes for Cambridge International AS & A Level Sociology (9699) in a single volume. 136 lessons covering socialisation, culture and identity, methods of research, the family, education and inequality, globalisation, the media and religion, with exam technique and practice papers for all four papers. Organised lesson by lesson to follow the syllabus.
